==Description==
'''A-135'''<nowiki/>'s appearance appears to depict a creepy or eerie face emerging from darkness, with only the teeth and part of a circular mouth shape visible.

==Behavior==
A-135 spawns behind the current room’s door making drumming sounds. After 3-5 seconds, A-135 breaks the door before checking every gray locker in the current 5-6 rooms. After checking A-135 will backtrack and despawning once it reaches the void wall. Any player found or getting close will get jumpscared by A-135.
 
==Lore==
*'''A-135''' is also known as Void's "Special Boy".

== Strategies & Tips ==

* To survive '''A-135''', you need to hide in a blue locker, table, green locker, or fridge.

==Trivia==
*'''A-135''' was made to mimic [[A-120]]'s drumming sounds, meaning players mistake it for [[A-120]] and hide in a white locker and die.
*'''A-135'''<nowiki/>'s old name was A-175
*'''A-135's''' old design originally was a concept design for [[D-250]]
*Tables only work on A-135 (and its [[A-135i|i Variant]]) within [[Section A]], As long with ''partially'' [[A-20i]]  and [[A-60i]]
*It's safe to use fridges and green locker as they won't be checked by '''A-135'''
*In Chaos Mode, '''A-135''' can spawn with D-140, M-150 or M-200. If it spawns with:
**D-140: hide under a table ([[Section A]] and [[Section M|Section M {Tunnels}]]), quickly switch lockers after D-140 checks them or viceversa or go to the last room where Void is and hide (non of these two check the last room's lockers)
**M-150: if its blue, hide under a table ([[Section A]] and [[Section M|Section M {Tunnels}]]), quickly switch lockers after it checks them or go 3 rooms back as M-150 only checks the first two rooms
**M-200: hide under a table (A sector or M sector {tunnels}) or wait for a miracle to happen
***Since it destroys blue lockers, all the player has are normal lockers, so pray for luck if you're not in [[Section A]] or [[Section M|Section M {Tunnels}]].
*In [[Section D]] with Chaos Mode A-135 considers white cabinets as blue lockers and supply cabinets as normal lockers
